<style>
/* ==========================================================================
   DSD Properties — Saumitra Vihar Yojana (UPAVP, Lucknow)
   Article styles · v3 · last updated 04 September 2026
   ========================================================================== */
:root{
  --dsd-navy:#011f4b;
  --dsd-navy-soft:#0a2f66;
  --dsd-teal:#008080;
  --dsd-teal-bright:#20B2AA;
  --dsd-orange:#FF5C00;
  --dsd-red:#d92d20;
  --dsd-green:#087443;
  --dsd-light-teal:#e6f7f7;
  --dsd-surface:#ffffff;
  --dsd-bg:#f7f9fb;
  --dsd-border:#e3e8ef;
  --dsd-text:#334155;
  --dsd-muted:#64748b;
  --dsd-radius:14px;
  --dsd-radius-sm:10px;
  --dsd-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(1,31,75,.06), 0 8px 24px rgba(1,31,75,.06);
  --dsd-shadow-lg:0 4px 12px rgba(1,31,75,.08), 0 20px 48px rgba(1,31,75,.10);
  --dsd-font:'Poppins', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
}

.dsd-sourceline{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dsd-muted);margin:0 0 26px;padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--dsd-border);line-height:1.7;}

/* status ribbon */
.dsd-ribbon{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:10px 18px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--dsd-navy) 0%,#062a5e 55%,#0b3a7a 100%);border-radius:var(--dsd-radius);padding:16px 20px;margin:0 0 22px;box-shadow:var(--dsd-shadow-lg);}
.dsd-ribbon span.dsd-ribbon-pill.dsd-ribbon-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);color:#011f4b !important;font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;padding:6px 13px;border-radius:999px;}
.dsd-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;}
.dsd-dot.live{background:#ff6b4a;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,107,74,.7);animation:dsdPulse 2s infinite;}
.dsd-dot.wait{background:#fbbf24;}
.dsd-dot.done{background:#34d399;}
@keyframes dsdPulse{70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 9px rgba(255,107,74,0);}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,107,74,0);}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.dsd-dot.live{animation:none;}}
.dsd-ribbon span.dsd-ribbon-date.dsd-ribbon-date{margin-left:auto;font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.88) !important;letter-spacing:.04em;font-weight:500;}

/* stats bar */
.dsd-stats-bar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(132px,1fr));gap:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-radius:var(--dsd-radius);overflow:hidden;margin:22px 0 28px;box-shadow:var(--dsd-shadow-lg);}
.dsd-stat-item{padding:18px 14px;text-align:center;background:var(--dsd-navy);transition:background .25s ease;}
.dsd-stat-item:hover{background:var(--dsd-navy-soft);}
.dsd-stats-bar .dsd-stat-item span.dsd-stat-num{font-size:19px;font-weight:700;color:#5eead4 !important;display:block;line-height:1.15;font-family:var(--dsd-font);white-space:nowrap;}
.dsd-stats-bar .dsd-stat-item span.dsd-stat-num.sm{font-size:15px;white-space:normal;line-height:1.25;}
.dsd-stats-bar .dsd-stat-item span.dsd-stat-label{font-size:10.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.86) !important;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;margin-top:5px;display:block;font-family:var(--dsd-font);line-height:1.4;}

/* alerts */
.dsd-alert{border-radius:var(--dsd-radius);padding:18px 22px;margin:24px 0;border:1px solid;border-left-width:4px;box-shadow:var(--dsd-shadow);}
.dsd-alert h4{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--dsd-font);line-height:1.45;}
.dsd-alert ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;}
.dsd-alert li{font-size:14px;color:var(--dsd-text);padding:7px 0 7px 22px;position:relative;line-height:1.78;}
.dsd-alert li + li{border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.05);}
.dsd-alert li::before{position:absolute;left:0;font-weight:700;}
.dsd-alert p{font-size:14px;color:var(--dsd-text);line-height:1.78;margin:0;}
.dsd-alert.info{background:#fff8f0;border-color:rgba(255,92,0,.22);border-left-color:var(--dsd-orange);}
.dsd-alert.info h4{color:var(--dsd-orange);}
.dsd-alert.info li::before{content:'→';color:var(--dsd-orange);}
.dsd-alert.good{background:var(--dsd-light-teal);border-color:rgba(0,128,128,.22);border-left-color:var(--dsd-teal);}
.dsd-alert.good h4{color:var(--dsd-navy);}
.dsd-alert.good li::before{content:'✓';color:var(--dsd-teal);}
.dsd-alert.danger{background:#fff5f4;border-color:rgba(217,45,32,.24);border-left-color:var(--dsd-red);}
.dsd-alert.danger h4{color:var(--dsd-red);}
.dsd-alert.danger li::before{content:'✕';color:var(--dsd-red);}

/* pull quote */
.dsd-pullquote{border-left:4px solid var(--dsd-orange);background:#fff8f5;padding:20px 24px;margin:26px 0;border-radius:0 var(--dsd-radius) var(--dsd-radius) 0;}
.dsd-pullquote p{font-size:15.5px;font-style:italic;color:var(--dsd-navy);line-height:1.78;margin:0 0 8px;}
.dsd-pullquote cite{font-size:12px;color:var(--dsd-muted);font-style:normal;}

/* TOC */
.dsd-toc{background:var(--dsd-bg);border:1px solid var(--dsd-border);border-radius:var(--dsd-radius);padding:20px 22px;margin:24px 0;}
.dsd-toc h2{margin:0 0 14px !important;font-size:16px !important;color:var(--dsd-navy);border:none !important;padding:0 !important;}
.dsd-toc ol{list-style:none;counter-reset:dsdtoc;padding:0;margin:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:2px 20px;}
.dsd-toc li{counter-increment:dsdtoc;margin:0;}
.dsd-toc a{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:baseline;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:var(--dsd-radius-sm);text-decoration:none;color:var(--dsd-text);font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;transition:background .18s ease,color .18s ease;}
.dsd-toc a::before{content:counter(dsdtoc,decimal-leading-zero);font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--dsd-teal);flex-shrink:0;}
.dsd-toc a:hover,.dsd-toc a:focus-visible{background:#fff;color:var(--dsd-navy);box-shadow:var(--dsd-shadow);}

/* map */
.dsd-map{border:1px solid var(--dsd-border);border-radius:var(--dsd-radius);overflow:hidden;margin:22px 0;background:var(--dsd-surface);box-shadow:var(--dsd-shadow);}
.dsd-map-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:14px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--dsd-border);background:var(--dsd-bg);}
.dsd-map .dsd-map-head span.dsd-pin{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--dsd-teal);color:#ffffff !important;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;flex-shrink:0;}
.dsd-map-title{font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--dsd-navy);margin:0;line-height:1.35;}
.dsd-map-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--dsd-muted);margin:2px 0 0;line-height:1.45;}
.dsd-map .dsd-map-head a.dsd-map-btn{margin-left:auto;background:#B83C00;color:#ffffff !important;font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;border:none;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease;white-space:nowrap;}
.dsd-map .dsd-map-head a.dsd-map-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(184,60,0,.38);color:#ffffff !important;}
.dsd-map-frame{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;min-height:260px;max-height:420px;
  background-color:#e9eff6;
  background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(1,31,75,.055) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(1,31,75,.055) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(0,128,128,.10) 0%,transparent 55%);
  background-size:32px 32px,32px 32px,100% 100%;}
.dsd-map-frame iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;display:block;}
.dsd-map-placeholder{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;text-align:center;padding:24px;cursor:pointer;border:0;background:transparent;width:100%;font-family:inherit;}
.dsd-map-placeholder span.dsd-mp-icon{font-size:26px;line-height:1;width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--dsd-border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:var(--dsd-shadow);}
.dsd-map-placeholder:hover span.dsd-mp-icon{border-color:var(--dsd-teal);}
.dsd-map-placeholder span.dsd-mp-text{font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--dsd-navy);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--dsd-border);padding:9px 18px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:var(--dsd-shadow);}
.dsd-map-placeholder span.dsd-mp-hint{font-size:12px;color:var(--dsd-muted);max-width:380px;line-height:1.6;}
.dsd-map-foot{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding:12px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--dsd-border);background:var(--dsd-bg);}
.dsd-coord{font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--dsd-muted);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--dsd-border);padding:4px 10px;border-radius:6px;}

/* plot cards */
.dsd-plot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:12px;margin:22px 0;}
.dsd-plot-card{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#011f4b 0%,#0a2f66 100%);border:1px solid rgba(32,178,170,.34);border-radius:var(--dsd-radius-sm);padding:18px 14px;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease;}
.dsd-plot-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(1,31,75,.24);}
.dsd-plot-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 0%,rgba(32,178,170,.28) 0%,transparent 62%);pointer-events:none;}
.dsd-plot-card > *{position:relative;z-index:1;}
.dsd-plot-grid .dsd-plot-card span.dsd-plot-size{font-size:19px;font-weight:700;color:#ffffff !important;display:block;font-family:var(--dsd-font);line-height:1.15;}
.dsd-plot-grid .dsd-plot-card span.dsd-plot-sqft{font-size:12.5px;color:#5eead4 !important;display:block;margin-top:4px;font-weight:600;font-family:var(--dsd-font);}
.dsd-plot-grid .dsd-plot-card span.dsd-plot-count{display:inline-block;margin-top:9px;font-size:11px;font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-weight:700;color:#011f4b !important;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #ffffff;padding:3px 11px;border-radius:999px;}

/* estimator */
.dsd-calc{background:var(--dsd-surface);border:1px solid var(--dsd-border);border-top:3px solid var(--dsd-teal);border-radius:var(--dsd-radius);padding:20px 22px;margin:24px 0;box-shadow:var(--dsd-shadow);}
.dsd-calc h4{font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--dsd-navy);margin:0 0 4px;}
.dsd-calc .dsd-calc-note{font-size:12px;color:var(--dsd-muted);margin:0 0 16px;line-height:1.6;}
.dsd-calc-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:16px;}
.dsd-calc-opt{border:1px solid var(--dsd-border);background:var(--dsd-bg);color:var(--dsd-text);font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;padding:9px 15px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s ease;}
.dsd-calc-opt:hover{border-color:var(--dsd-teal);color:var(--dsd-navy);}
.dsd-calc-opt[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--dsd-teal);border-color:var(--dsd-teal);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,128,128,.28);}
.dsd-calc-out{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:12px;}
.dsd-calc-cell{background:var(--dsd-bg);border:1px solid var(--dsd-border);border-radius:var(--dsd-radius-sm);padding:14px 16px;}
.dsd-calc-cell .dsd-cc-label{font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dsd-muted);display:block;margin-bottom:5px;}
.dsd-calc-cell .dsd-cc-val{font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:var(--dsd-navy);display:block;line-height:1.25;}

/* timeline */
.dsd-timeline{position:relative;margin:24px 0;padding-left:30px;}
.dsd-timeline::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:9px;top:6px;bottom:6px;width:2px;background:var(--dsd-border);}
.dsd-tl-item{position:relative;padding:0 0 20px;}
.dsd-tl-item:last-child{padding-bottom:0;}
.dsd-tl-item::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-26px;top:4px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--dsd-border);z-index:1;}
.dsd-tl-item.done::before{background:var(--dsd-green);border-color:var(--dsd-green);}
.dsd-tl-item.active::before{background:var(--dsd-orange);border-color:var(--dsd-orange);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,92,0,.16);}
.dsd-tl-date{font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dsd-teal);display:block;margin-bottom:3px;}
.dsd-tl-title{font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--dsd-navy);margin:0 0 3px;}
.dsd-tl-desc{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--dsd-muted);margin:0;line-height:1.7;}

/* feature cards */
.dsd-zone-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(196px,1fr));gap:14px;margin:22px 0;}
.dsd-zone-card{background:var(--dsd-surface);border:1px solid var(--dsd-border);border-top:3px solid var(--dsd-teal);border-radius:var(--dsd-radius-sm);padding:16px 18px;box-shadow:var(--dsd-shadow);transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease;}
.dsd-zone-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:var(--dsd-shadow-lg);}
.dsd-zone-card.orange{border-top-color:var(--dsd-orange);}
.dsd-zone-card h5{color:var(--dsd-navy);font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 6px;}
.dsd-zone-card p{font-size:13px;color:var(--dsd-muted);margin:0;line-height:1.65;}

/* village tags */
.dsd-village-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:16px 0;}
.dsd-village-tag{background:var(--dsd-light-teal);border:1px solid rgba(0,128,128,.26);color:var(--dsd-navy);padding:6px 14px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;}

/* pros & cons */
.dsd-inv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin:22px 0;}
.dsd-inv-card{border-radius:var(--dsd-radius);padding:20px 18px;border:1px solid;box-shadow:var(--dsd-shadow);}
.dsd-inv-card.pro{background:#f2fbf6;border-color:rgba(8,116,67,.22);}
.dsd-inv-card.con{background:#fff8f0;border-color:rgba(255,92,0,.24);}
.dsd-inv-card h4{font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 12px;}
.dsd-inv-card.pro h4{color:var(--dsd-green);}
.dsd-inv-card.con h4{color:var(--dsd-orange);}
.dsd-inv-card ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;}
.dsd-inv-card li{font-size:13.5px;padding:7px 0 7px 20px;position:relative;color:var(--dsd-text);line-height:1.72;}
.dsd-inv-card li + li{border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.05);}
.dsd-inv-card li::before{position:absolute;left:0;font-weight:700;}
.dsd-inv-card.pro li::before{content:'✓';color:var(--dsd-green);}
.dsd-inv-card.con li::before{content:'!';color:var(--dsd-orange);}

/* steps */
.dsd-steps{margin:24px 0;}
.dsd-step-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:15px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.dsd-steps .dsd-step-row div.dsd-step-num{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--dsd-teal);color:#ffffff !important;font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;}
.dsd-step-num.orange{background:var(--dsd-orange);}
.dsd-step-body{background:var(--dsd-surface);border:1px solid var(--dsd-border);border-radius:var(--dsd-radius-sm);padding:13px 17px;flex:1;box-shadow:var(--dsd-shadow);}
.dsd-step-title{font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--dsd-navy);margin:0 0 4px;}
.dsd-step-desc{font-size:13.3px;color:var(--dsd-muted);margin:0;line-height:1.68;}

/* tables */
.dsd-table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;margin:22px 0;border:1px solid var(--dsd-border);border-radius:var(--dsd-radius);box-shadow:var(--dsd-shadow);-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;}
.dsd-table-wrap table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:0 !important;font-size:14px;min-width:520px;}
.dsd-table-wrap table thead tr th{background:var(--dsd-navy);color:#ffffff !important;font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;text-align:left;padding:13px 16px;white-space:nowrap;}
.dsd-table-wrap tbody td{padding:12px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--dsd-border);color:var(--dsd-text);line-height:1.6;vertical-align:top;}
.dsd-table-wrap tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:var(--dsd-bg);}
.dsd-table-wrap tbody tr:hover{background:var(--dsd-light-teal);}
.dsd-badge{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap;}
.dsd-badge.ok{background:#dcfce7;color:#065f36 !important;}
.dsd-badge.wait{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e !important;}
.dsd-badge.no{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b !important;}

/* link cards */
.dsd-related-inline{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:12px;margin:22px 0;}
.dsd-link-card{background:var(--dsd-bg);border:1px solid var(--dsd-border);border-radius:var(--dsd-radius-sm);padding:15px 17px;text-decoration:none;display:block;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s,transform .2s;}
.dsd-link-card:hover,.dsd-link-card:focus-visible{border-color:var(--dsd-teal);box-shadow:var(--dsd-shadow-lg);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.dsd-link-label{font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dsd-teal);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:5px;}
.dsd-link-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--dsd-navy);line-height:1.45;}
.dsd-inline-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:var(--dsd-bg);border:1px solid var(--dsd-border);border-left:3px solid var(--dsd-teal);border-radius:0 var(--dsd-radius-sm) var(--dsd-radius-sm) 0;padding:13px 17px;text-decoration:none;margin:20px 0;transition:border-left-color .2s,background .2s;}
.dsd-inline-link:hover{border-left-color:var(--dsd-orange);background:#fff;}
.dsd-il-label{font-family:var(--dsd-font);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dsd-teal);font-weight:700;}
.dsd-il-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--dsd-navy);margin-top:3px;line-height:1.45;}
.dsd-il-arrow{margin-left:auto;color:var(--dsd-teal);font-size:18px;flex-shrink:0;}

/* checklist */
.dsd-checklist{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;counter-reset:dsdchk;}
.dsd-checklist li{counter-increment:dsdchk;position:relative;padding:11px 0 11px 34px;font-size:14px;color:var(--dsd-text);line-height:1.72;}
.dsd-checklist li + li{border-top:1px solid rgba(217,45,32,.1);}

<p>If you have been waiting for a plot in a planned Lucknow township, this is probably the scheme you have been hearing about. <strong>Saumitra Vihar Yojana</strong> is a new township coming up on <strong>New Jail Road in Gosainganj</strong>, being built by the <strong>Uttar Pradesh Awas Vikas Parishad</strong>. This guide will tell you everything that is confirmed, everything that is still uncertain, and exactly what to check before you pay a single rupee.</p>

<h2 id="what-is">What is Saumitra Vihar Yojana?</h2>
<p>Saumitra Vihar is a planned residential township on New Jail Road, in the Gosainganj–<a href="https://dsdproperties.in/blog/mohanlalganj-lucknow-real-estate-guide-2026" style="color:#008080;font-weight:600;">Mohanlalganj</a> area of Lucknow. It is being developed by the <strong>Uttar Pradesh Awas Vikas Parishad</strong>, also called the UP Housing and Development Board.</p>
<p>The project got its name fairly recently. In <strong>December 2024</strong>, the Parishad announced a new residential scheme on Lucknow’s New Jail Road. Then in the <strong>270th board meeting in March 2025</strong>, the board formally approved the name — Saumitra Vihar Yojana.</p>
<p>One thing people get confused about, so let us clear it up straight away:</p>
<div class="dsd-alert good">
<h4>This is UPAVP, not LDA</h4>
<ul>
<li>IT City, Wellness City, <a href="https://dsdproperties.in/blog/anant-nagar-yojana-lucknow-lda-2026" style="color:#008080;font-weight:600;">Anant Nagar</a> and Varun Vihar are <strong>LDA</strong> schemes (Lucknow Development Authority).</li>
<li>Saumitra Vihar is <strong>UPAVP</strong> (<a href="https://dsdproperties.in/awas-vikas-schemes" style="color:#008080;font-weight:600;">Awas Vikas Parishad</a>). Different body, different website, different application process.</li>
<li>You will apply on <strong>upavp.in</strong> for this one — not on the LDA portal.</li>
<li>Both are government organisations, so the plots are equally genuine. Just do not mix up the two portals when registration opens.</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="land-pooling">How land pooling works here</h2>
<p>This is the part that makes Saumitra Vihar special, and it is worth understanding properly — especially if you own land anywhere on the outskirts of Lucknow, because this model is likely to be repeated.</p>
<p>Normally, when the government needs land for a township, it acquires it. A notice is issued, a compensation amount is fixed, and the farmer gets money whether he agrees with the price or not. You know what usually happens next — court cases, <a href="https://dsdproperties.in/blog/property-stay-order-injunction-lucknow-2026" style="color:#008080;font-weight:600;">stay orders</a>, and projects stuck for ten years.</p>
<p><strong>Land pooling works differently.</strong> The farmer is not forced. He gives his land willingly, and instead of only cash, he gets a share of the same land back — but now developed, with roads, drainage and electricity, and with clean papers. Agricultural land that was worth very little suddenly becomes a proper residential plot he can sell or build on.</p>
<div class="dsd-alert good">
<h4>What has already happened with the farmers</h4>
<ul>
<li>Farmers gave land <strong>willingly</strong>. There was no forced acquisition notice in this scheme.</li>
<li><strong>The registry is complete.</strong> The land has been formally transferred into the Parishad’s name.</li>
<li><strong>192 farmers have already received developed plots</strong> through a lottery draw.</li>
<li>Because everyone agreed, there is very little chance of a land dispute surfacing later.</li>
<li>This is the <strong>first township in Uttar Pradesh</strong> to be built this way.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<p>Why should you care as a buyer? Simple. <strong>Most plot frauds and most stuck projects in UP come from land disputes.</strong> Someone challenges the acquisition, a court puts a stay, and your money sits blocked for years. When land comes through pooling with everyone’s consent and the registry already done, that whole category of risk mostly goes away.</p>
<p>It does not mean you skip verification. It just means the most common problem is much less likely here.</p>

<h2>Common questions about Saumitra Vihar Yojana</h2>
<h3>What is Saumitra Vihar Yojana Lucknow?</h3>
<p>Saumitra Vihar Yojana is a new residential township being developed by the Uttar Pradesh Awas Vikas Parishad on New Jail Road in the Gosainganj area of Lucknow, near Sithauli Khurd, PIN 226501. It covers around 560 acres and more than 5,000 plots are planned in total. The first phase will offer 2,092 residential plots and 169 commercial plots. It is the first township in Uttar Pradesh where land was taken from farmers through land pooling with their consent, instead of forced acquisition.</p>
<h3>Has Saumitra Vihar registration opened?</h3>
<p>No, not yet. As of 4 September 2026 there is no registration link, brochure or price list on upavp.in. The scheme was first meant to launch on 13 January 2025 at the Prayagraj Mahakumbh but got delayed. UPAVP filed its RERA registration application on 11 August 2026, and once that clears, public registration will be opened. Keep checking upavp.in, and please do not pay anyone claiming to book a plot before the official window opens.</p>
<h3>Is Saumitra Vihar RERA approved?</h3>
<p>No. The scheme is not RERA approved at the moment. UPAVP submitted its registration application on the UP RERA portal on 11 August 2026, and UP RERA has confirmed that document verification has begun. That means the application is under review, not cleared. When the brochure is finally released, take the RERA number from it and check it yourself on up-rera.in before applying. Anyone telling you today that this scheme is already RERA registered is giving you wrong information.</p>
<h3>What are the plot sizes in Saumitra Vihar?</h3>
<p>Phase 1 has six residential sizes: 40.74 sq m (80 plots), 60.29 sq m (229 plots), 75 sq m (598 plots), 122.23 sq m (445 plots), 200 sq m (579 plots) and 300 sq m (161 plots). That adds up to 2,092 plots. Commercial plots come in three sizes: 100 sq m (107 plots), 200 sq m (57 plots) and 1,375 sq m (5 plots), totalling 169.</p>
<h3>What will a plot in Saumitra Vihar cost?</h3>
<p>The expected land rate is around ₹3,000 to ₹3,500 per square foot, which works out to roughly ₹32,300 to ₹37,700 per square metre. On that basis a 75 sq m plot would cost about ₹24.22 to ₹28.26 lakh, and a 300 sq m plot about ₹96.88 lakh to ₹1.13 crore, before registry and stamp duty. Please remember UPAVP has not released an official price list yet, so treat these as estimates only. Earlier reports had put the rate near ₹25,000–₹26,000 per sq m, about ₹2,300–₹2,400 per sq ft — that was the older estimate and it has since been revised upward.</p>
<h3>Who is developing Saumitra Vihar — UPAVP or LDA?</h3>
<p>UPAVP, the Uttar Pradesh Awas Vikas Parishad, also known as the UP Housing and Development Board. This is a different body from the Lucknow Development Authority, which develops IT City, Wellness City, Anant Nagar and Varun Vihar. Both are government organisations but they have separate websites and separate application processes. For Saumitra Vihar you will apply on upavp.in, not on the LDA portal.</p>
<h3>Who can apply for a Saumitra Vihar plot?</h3>
<p>Two conditions have been reported so far: you must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh, and your age should be between 18 and 55 years. UPAVP has not published the complete eligibility rules yet, and the brochure may add more conditions such as income limits, rules about existing property, and reservation categories. So please wait for the official brochure before assuming whether you qualify.</p>
<h3>What makes the land pooling model here different?</h3>
<p>In normal land acquisition, the government issues a notice and fixes compensation whether the farmer agrees or not, which often leads to court cases and stalled projects. In land pooling, farmers give their land willingly and get developed plots back in return. Saumitra Vihar is the first township in Uttar Pradesh built this way. The land has already been registered in the Parishad’s name and 192 farmers have received their developed plots through a lottery. For buyers, this means much lower risk of a land dispute surfacing later.</p>
<h3>Can I book a plot in advance through an agent or broker?</h3>
<p>No, and anyone offering this is trying to cheat you. There is no advance booking system in this scheme at all. UPAVP allots plots only through a computerised lottery after an official online registration window opens. There is no priority quota, no special booking and no way for anyone to guarantee you a plot. All payments go through the UPAVP website only — never cash, never UPI to a personal number, never a cheque to an individual. The only official website is upavp.in.</p>
<h3>How many sectors does Saumitra Vihar have?</h3>
<p>The official layout plan has not been published yet, so the sector details are not confirmed. You may find articles online listing specific sector names or numbers, but these cannot be verified until UPAVP releases the official layout along with the brochure. Please do not choose or pay for a plot in a particular sector based on unofficial information.</p>
<h3>Is Saumitra Vihar a good investment in 2026?</h3>
<p>The basics are strong. It is a government scheme, the land came through consent-based pooling so dispute risk is low, the registry is already done, and the project is large at 560 acres. On the other side, RERA approval is still pending, registration has not opened, there is no official price list, the expected rate has already been revised upward once to ₹3,000–₹3,500 per sq ft, and site development has not started. Treat this as a 3 to 5 year investment. Apply through the official lottery when it opens, pay only the official rate, and do not give money to anyone before the brochure exists.</p>
<h3>Where exactly is Saumitra Vihar located?</h3>
<p>The site is on New Jail Road in the Gosainganj area near Mohanlalganj, Lucknow, around Sithauli Khurd at PIN 226501. The coordinates are approximately 26.7244 degrees North and 81.0690 degrees East. Land for the township came from villages in this belt including Mohari Kala, Sithauli Kala and Sithauli Khurd. Please keep in mind it is open land at the moment, mostly farmland, with limited facilities nearby.</p>
